<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Defines a new `RsiAlphaModel` that uses Wilder's RSI as a signal source.
This PR also includes a fix for `PortofolioTarget.Percent` to properly use the buying power model when determining how much quantity to purchase. Without this change, 99% of the generated orders were failing as invalid (insufficient funds), but now they're working :)

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #1779 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
This is part of a continued effort to fill out some example models in the framework ecosystem.

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
Yes. This should be included in documentation.

<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->

pr_comments:
Review comments addressed. Also added the simplest possible alpha model, an EMA cross that doesn't use history for seeding and doesn't have any bounce tolerance or other goodies. Indicators are registered using the security's resolution and are never unregistered, but they are reset if a security leaves and comes back into the universe.

Also includes a rename of `SimplePortfolioConstructionModel` -> `EqualWeightingPortoflioConstructionModel`
